surprises: THIS INSTANCE READS `INVALID` AND THE CAUSE IS UPSTREAM OF IT -- stated here rather than left for the reader to discover. proof-of-spec-check reports 3 violations, all ONE root cause: its CELL_ID_RE is `\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-(?:m-[a-z0-9_]+|[a-z]{1,4}-[a-z]?\d+)\b`, which requires a LOWERCASE segment, so `INGEST-T3-6` and `INGEST-T5-1` do not match and read as non-existent cells; the same non-match makes the whole <owned_cells> content read as `non-id text`. MEASURED, and it inverts the obvious reading: across 31 DECOMP.md files in workflows/atom_decomposition/runs, 30 use the checker-visible lowercase form and etfs-ingest is the SOLE outlier (29 uppercase INGEST-T* ids, of which the checker sees ZERO -- the `id space = 4` it prints is the incidental ETFS-d-*/ETFS-e-* family, a different naming family that happens to appear in the same file). SO THE DECOMP IS THE OUTLIER, NOT THE REGEX. I had it backwards until I ran the denominator. CONTROL: the already-filed ETFS_INGEST.TO-9-AE instance fails identically (3 alignment violations, same class), so this is PRE-EXISTING and systemic to the project, not introduced by this TO. CONSEQUENCE: every proof-of-spec instance for ETFS_INGEST is INVALID on alignment regardless of row quality. NOT ADJUDICATED HERE -- whether the remedy is renaming 29 cells in the decomp or widening the regex is the decomp author's / CVO's call, and the two have very different blast radii. Surfaced to 2.0.0_SA_COO~Z and 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z. Row quality itself is clean: the one violation that WAS mine (a missing status_reason on the event-gated AC3) is fixed, taking violations 4 -> 3. || AMENDED 2026-08-28T19:1xZ -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z RULED it (msg 13736) and the disposition above is SUPERSEDED: NEITHER rename NOR widen -- ADD A NARROW THIRD BRANCH for the INGEST-T<n>-<n> shape, shipped with a control showing zero non-id matches across the corpus plus a positive control that it now sees the 29 ids. Rename REJECTED (invalidates a CERTIFIED decomp @fcdf042972 and ~10 TOs' citations); widen REJECTED AS FRAMED (relaxation is what the residue check exists to catch). Placement is 2.0.0_SA_COO~Z's; not this seat's to take unilaterally. AND THE RULING CORRECTS MY FRAMING, which I am recording rather than quietly restating: I wrote 'THE DECOMP IS THE OUTLIER, NOT THE REGEX'. Verified at source, .tools/proof-of-spec-check.py:180-191, the regex is an ENUMERATED SET of shapes validated against exactly TWO decomps (etfs-positioning -> 23 ids, d1-catviews -> 28) -- so the etfs-ingest form was never in the validation sample rather than being a deviation from a declared rule, and my 30-of-31 census measures a HABIT, not conformance (2.0.0_SA_COO~Z's point, adopted by the ruling: you cannot adjudicate conformance to a rule nobody can read). THIS IS THE SECOND INSTANCE OF THE CLASS, NOT THE FIRST: the same comment block records wave 4's '-m-' mechanism form going invisible the same way -- '5 real ids invisible, and the violations they produced were worded AGAINST THE ISSUER (75278)' -- and the remedy taken then was also a narrow added branch. The recurring cost is MISATTRIBUTION: these violations read as though an executor got cell_refs wrong. AND THE CONVENTION IS DECLARED IN THE WRONG PLACE -- that comment block is a complete statement of the enumerated shapes and why each is narrow, but it lives in the enforcer instead of org/standards/, so only the tool that enforces it can read it.
